reason: A DSH Web client theme plugin whose primary purpose is visual customization, supplemented by an interactive Shiroko desktop companion and synchronized assistant-response bubbles.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 客户端提供蔚蓝档案风格的界面主题、可交互桌宠、助手回复气泡同步和可选完成提示音。
summaries.en: Adds a Blue Archive-inspired theme to the DSH Web client with an interactive desktop companion, synchronized assistant reply bubbles, and an optional completion chime.

capabilities: Customizes the DSH Web client interface
Adds a draggable and interactive desktop companion
Reads assistant output from the current page DOM for synchronized bubbles
Stores settings and position in browser localStorage
Generates an optional completion sound with Web Audio API
